name: Contact scorecard
pitch: Show a table of the person's top 20 contacts with their average reply time and message importance.
instructions: Start by running mail_list to get the person's mailbox list. Then run mail_read on each of the top 20 conversations. For each contact, calculate the average time between their messages and the person's replies. Give each message a value label of high, medium or low based on the sender's usual importance. If a contact has fewer than three messages, note that there is not enough data. When the calculations are done, use make_page to create a simple table showing contact name, average reply time, and value label. If any tool is not connected, say so and stop. Do not give the person a name. Do not invent reply times or value labels.

examples.does: run mail_list and then mail_read on the latest conversations
list the mailbox, read top threads, calculate times and labels, then show the table

readme: A bot pack that reads the person's mail, calculates reply-time averages and value labels for their top 20 contacts, and displays the results in a table. It needs access to the mail connector. It will not post, send or delete any mail.
